scientific_role: consumed-cohort development of selector-level whole-population spatial holdout

candidate_surface.common_eligible_surface_rule: training-built terrain surface points with nearest training occurrence distance >0.5 km

selectors.environment: validated_robust_candidate_patches applied to the common eligible surface using training-only terrain prototypes
selectors.nearest_known: ascending distance to training occurrences on the common eligible surface
selectors.spatial_balance: deterministic farthest-point spatial balance on the common eligible surface
selectors.random: seeded random selection on the common eligible surface
selectors.matched_k: k equals the environment selector candidate count on the common eligible surface

claim_boundary: The frozen 48 plant pairs are already consumed and may only support development. Whole-population holdout diagnoses hidden-population recovery without temporal provider dependence, but promotion requires a fresh disjoint plant cohort frozen before occurrence rows are opened.
